description: Na₂MoAs₂O₉ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.78 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.80 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.53 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two MoO₆ octahedra and corners with three AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-19°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.77 Å. There are two inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MoO₆ octahedra that share corners with four AsO₄ tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-2.27 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MoO₆ octahedra that share corners with four AsO₄ tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-2.26 Å. There are four inequivalent As sites. In the first As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two MoO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one AsO₄ tetrahedra, and  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-51°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.68-1.80 Å. In the second As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two MoO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-51°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.68-1.80 Å. In the third As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two MoO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one AsO₄ tetrahedra, and  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-59°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.66-1.81 Å. In the fourth As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two MoO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one AsO₄ tetrahedra, and  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-58°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.66-1.81 Å. There are eighteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one As atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one As atom.
